{{Quote|Those who resist Imperial rule would die by my hands.|Darth Hadra to the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Right to Arms" />}}
'''Darth Hadra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who served as a member of the [[Dark Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
It was rumored that Hadra had ascended to her position of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] by an affair with [[Darth Malgus]], but the rumors were false&mdash;she had simply murdered her opponents and enemies to achieve her position. A rival of [[Darth Mekhis]], Hadra presided over the Empire's capital world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in addition to the [[Sphere of Technology]]&mdash;one of the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] that were each controlled by a member of the Council. Hadra gained her seat on the Dark Council after a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Mission to the Vesla system|operation]] resulted in Mekhis's disappearance. When her forces discovered an ancient Sith shrine near [[Kaas City]], she attempted to claim it as her territory, but [[Darth Arctis]]&mdash;the leader of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]]&mdash;protested her claim and became embroiled in a conflict with Hadra.

During [[3640 BBY]], Hadra and fellow Dark Councilor [[Darth Acharon]] traveled to the contested [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to reinforce [[Darth Decimus]], head of the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]], in the war effort there. Darth Hadra along with Acharon and Decimus were called via holo to an emergency Dark Council meeting by Darth Baras, who attempted to claim the position of Emperor's Voice and was then struck down by the Emperor's Wrath, then Hadra and the rest of the Dark Council pledged their loyalty to their Emperor's Wrath. During the Republic push on the [[Legislature Building]], Hadra locked herself in the safe room with the Corellian Council. When a Republic Hero arrived to oppose her, she stated that the Council joined the Empire willingly and her death would not change that. After an intense fight, Hadra was defeated and killed.

In the aftermath of her demise, the leadership of the Sphere of Technology that Darth Hadra had left vacant became a matter of dispute on the Dark Council, where two potential successors — the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Darth Karrid]] and the human [[Darth Gravus]] — were nominated by [[Darth Marr]] and [[Darth Mortis]] respectively. Though the latter was favoured because of the dominant [[speciesism]] which many on the Council harbored, Hadra was ultimately replaced by the former after Karrid provoked a [[Second battle of Leritor|battle]] with Gravus which led to his death. Not long after this induction, Karrid met her own end at the hands of Theron Shan, once again vacating the position,<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> which was then taken by [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="TOR-ROTHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Hadra was capable of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Hadra used a purple [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]]. She was also a superior combatant to Darth Mekhis.
